A LITTLE MORE CONTEXT

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Does Vestigo read my whole project?+

The current project brief uses package metadata, a short README excerpt when needed, and a bounded directory map. Saved memories give your agent a starting point. Agents still need to inspect the code relevant to their task.

Will it use extra AI credits?+

Vestigo itself makes no AI API calls for memory storage, validation, search, or export. Your connected assistant still uses tokens to write and read memories. Size estimates are approximate; actual savings have not been measured.

Does my AI save everything automatically?+

Connected MCP clients receive guidance to read context at the start and save meaningful checkpoints. The assistant controls when tools run. Vestigo does not intercept every chat or install session hooks automatically.

What happens when I clone the project?+

If the repository includes an exported vestigo.context.json, Vestigo reads its project-visible memories automatically. Private local memories stay on their original machine. Without an export, the basic project map still works.

What can I try today?+

Version 0.2.0 includes local agent memory, keyword retrieval, evidence fingerprints, portable exports, saved work history, and a VS Code sidebar. It currently uses the first workspace folder. Richer symbol mapping and automatic session hooks are future work.

Vestigo 0.2.0 is an early local extension. Use your project’s VSIX package or build from its source checkout.

  1. 01

    Install the extension.

    In VS Code, open Extensions → ⋯ → Install from VSIX, then select vestigo-0.2.0.vsix. Requires VS Code 1.102 or newer.

  2. 02

    Open Vestigo. Connect your AI.

    Open a trusted project, select the Vestigo activity-bar view, then choose Connect AI. Enable the local MCP tools in your assistant.

  3. 03

    Build something. Leave a checkpoint.

    Ask your AI to use get_project_brief when starting and record_work after meaningful work.

npm install && npm run build

Run the build command inside the Vestigo source checkout. No marketplace listing or hosted account is required.
